critical_operation.description: At v28.1 the START_GROUP case creates a new subFields builder, computes the matching end-group tag, and calls mergeFrom(subFields, reader) at line 78. mergeFrom (91-98) loops back into mergeOneFieldFrom for every member, so a message containing N nested SGROUP tags produces N nested mergeFrom/mergeOneFieldFrom Java frames. Neither method takes a depth argument, the class has no recursion limit, and no check is performed before recursing, so the only bound is the JVM thread stack. Any protobuf message whose schema does not declare the field reaches this branch: the field is treated as an unknown field and its group contents are parsed into UnknownFieldSetLite. The byte[] fast path has the same defect in ArrayDecoders.decodeUnknownField (1024-1040), and the discard-unknown-fields path has it in CodedInputStream.skipMessage (704-711). v28.2 fixes all three by adding DEFAULT_RECURSION_LIMIT = 100, a static recursionLimit and a currentDepth/registers.recursionDepth counter that throws InvalidProtocolBufferException.recursionLimitExceeded() before the recursive call.
critical_operation.line_note: WIRETYPE_START_GROUP case spans 75-83; recursive mergeFrom(subFields, reader) at line 78; helper mergeFrom at 91-98

entry_point.description: A generated Java Lite message parsed with parseFrom(...) funnels into GeneratedMessageLite.Builder.mergeFrom(CodedInputStream) (548-564) or mergeFrom(byte[]) (522-538), which call MessageSchema.mergeFrom. For an unrecognised field, mergeFromHelper (declared 2962) at 3009 calls unknownFieldSchema.mergeOneFieldFrom, and when the wire type is WIRETYPE_START_GROUP the unknown-field merge recurses. With DiscardUnknownFieldsParser, the same parser sets discardUnknownFields, mergeFromHelper takes reader.skipField() at 3001, and CodedInputStream.skipField's START_GROUP case enters the unbounded skipMessage recursion. The helper runs to about 3414 and also calls mergeOneFieldFrom at 3384 and 3400 with skipField at 3393; the full-runtime run observed the GeneratedMessage.Builder.parseUnknownField -> UnknownFieldSet.Builder.mergeFieldFrom -> CodedInputStream.skipField path, so 3001 is a source-level path, not the one the bundled WKT classes exercise.
